style: Psychedelic funk with western and opera colour, 100 BPM, cut live and dry in one small wood-panelled studio room, every instrument close-mic'd, no reverb, no echo. Lead voice: a low, warm South London baritone from Brixton, round and relaxed, swallowing his T's and dropping his H's, talking the verses half-sung like a sly storyteller across a pub table, laid-back and in no hurry, never rapping, then opening up into a big soulful sung melody on the hooks while a gang of mates shouts the words back. Tight live drum kit, slinky fingered bass, choppy wah rhythm guitar, fuzz bass shadowing the bass line through the hooks. A lonesome western tin whistle carries the tune, and a twangy baritone guitar answers the vocal lines. One wordless operatic soprano holds long high notes behind the hooks only. Short, tidy ending.
exclude: sitar, tabla, drone, Indian, comedy, novelty, parody, kazoo, cartoon, trap, double-time, fast rap, autotune, EDM, country, smooth R&B, rap, hip hop, American accent, screaming, dancehall, ragga, toasting, reggaeton, reverb, echo, delay, dub, hall

[Intro: lonesome western tin whistle alone, then live kit, fingered bass and wah guitar fall in, dry small room]

[Verse 1: warm baritone, half-sung talk, close-mic and dry, twangy baritone guitar answers]

let's see, each day, make hay, not free, aay
work and get paid though, earning that dough
but where does it go? nobody knows!

means of production means a reduction
standards bleeding, land-lords needing
quantative easing, grandma FREEEEEEEZING!
stimulus checks are next. Get wrecked!

[Spoken Aside: dry and sly, bass and kit keep the pocket]
rent seeking?... I'm just about eating
sorry, did I interrupt your meeting?
remember kids, the Fed is not your friend!
it prints all the dollars that the government spends

[Pre-Chorus: voice starts to sing, wah guitar tightens]
this fiat system is insistent
on debts existence, sooooo
don't be hating on the credit rating
or have resistance to the facts I'm stating

[Chorus: big soulful sung melody, mates shout back, fuzz bass doubles the line, wordless soprano long high notes behind]
Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

[Verse 2: stripped to kit and fingered bass, relaxed half-sung talk, whistle answers]

distracted by a dispraxic flash,
mob, angry at their shitty little job
the right and the left both witness the theft

blaming each other is a sick little cover
institutional, dilutional, the usual
distraction IS the attraction
the intention is tension between the factions

divide and conquer, just look at the hand
It's not ya standard, propaganda, worth a couple grand-ahh
it is, state, level, manipulation
it is the devil, with a radio station

[Pre-Chorus: voice lifts into song, baritone guitar twang]
stack up the vaults like a wheelbarrow
risk of default is really rather narrow
Biggie said waaaay back in ninety seven
don't get high off your own supply

[Chorus: big soulful sung melody, mates shout back, fuzz bass doubles the line, wordless soprano long high notes behind]
Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

Robbery, robbery!
Call the police, it's a robbery!
Debasement! Debasement! It happened in da basement!
Printer is burrrrrrrrring, now now what's occurrrrrrrring?

[Verse 3: cheeky half-sung talk, close and dry, twangy baritone guitar replies between lines]
You know the real star is Pablo Escobar,
who has elastic bands not plastic hands,
stacking up the cash by the grands
standard plans are for the working man

and this right here is a next level scam
ill gotten gains, no need to explain
"bail" and "out", will never mean the same
own the printer and you don't fear winter

[Bridge: climbing but controlled, wah guitar and kit build]
crime is asset inflation, passive creation;
of a wealth gap that drives the situation
working people get paid in money, so it's not very funny
when you print more and expect them not to worry

[Final Chorus: full soulful voice, whole room sings along, fuzz bass, wordless soprano soaring high behind]
hungry people, feed a revolution,
then it's retribution, perhaps some execution
it's time to give, not just to take
but for heaven’s sake, don't just eat cake

[Outro: short, western whistle phrase over bass, band stops dead]

[End]
